label: Executor
description: Model-authored execution node. Receives a route plan and scribe contract, then emits an artifact proposal. The proposal must be extracted and validated by a script node before any authority state transition — the model only proposes, never disposes.

inputs.name: route_plan
inputs.description: Route plan from RouteSelected authority state

outputs.name: proposal
outputs.description: Model-authored artifact proposal. Tagged as a proposal — must be routed to a non-authority input (e.g. gateway_disposition.artifact_in or oracle_check.artifact_in) for extraction and scope validation before any authority input.
